data: From Negombo: Southern Coast Highlights Private Day Tour
item_page_title: private tourFrom Negombo: Southern Coast Highlights Private Day Tour12 hoursPickup availableNew activityFrom $ 120.00Per Person
Trip_Name: From Negombo: Southern Coast Highlights Private Day Tour
Description: Below are the locations for your day trip
Description_1: Below are the locations for your day trip1.Handunugoda Tea Factory2.Fishing at Ahangama3.Colonial city of Galle4.Kosgoda Turtle HatcheryStart your day tour with pickup from your hotel in Negombo at 6:30 AM. The first stop on your tour itinerary will be the Handunugoda Tea Factory which you will reach at approximately 9:30 AM. The Handunugoda Tea Factory reawakened the ancient Chinese tradition of creating Virgin White Tea, which is untouched by human hands during the manufacturing process. During the one-and-a-half-hour tour of the factory, see how this mysterious process takes place to create one of the top luxury teas in the world.Travel next to Ahangama to meet the stilt fishermen, who are one of the most iconic figures of Sri Lanka. Learn how they practice this unique and intricate fishing technique from a local practitioner of this ancient tradition.At approximately 12:00 PM you will stop for a lunch at your own expense in a place of your choosing, before reaching Galle at 2:00 PM. This coastal city has withstood three foreign invasions; during which time, it grew from a bustling port which was the main stop for ships travelling east, to a fortified and yet beautiful city with many monuments which have withstood the ravages of time. See the Galle Fort which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, the Galle Lighthouse, the National Maritime Museum, the picturesque cobblestoned streets, and many more colonial remnants.Leave Galle at 3:30 PM to visit the Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery, a journey that takes approximately 1 hour. Learn about the 5 types of sea turtles that visit Sri Lanka for nesting, and how the nests are protected. You will be able to see and touch baby turtles and view some of the fully-grown turtles that are treated for injuries and ailments. Return to your hotel by 8:30 PM to complete the excursion.

A bustling metropolis situated on the west coast of the island, Colombo is a fascinating mix of colonial charm, contemporary architecture, and lively local markets.Begin your day at Independence Square, a symbolic location that commemorates Sri Lanka's independence from British rule in 1948. The picturesque square features a monument and a surrounding park, providing a serene start to your exploration.Next, head to the National Museum of Colombo, where you can delve into the island's history. The museum houses a diverse collection, including artifacts from ancient kingdoms, traditional art, and exhibits on Sri Lanka's colonial past.Venture to Gangaramaya Temple, a prominent Buddhist temple that seamlessly integrates various architectural styles. The temple complex includes a museum, a library, and a sacred Bodhi tree, making it a spiritual and cultural hub.In the afternoon, immerse yourself in the vibrant chaos of Pettah Market. This bustling commercial area is a labyrinth of narrow streets filled with shops selling spices, textiles, jewelry, and an array of other goods. It's a sensory delight, and bargaining is a common practice.Explore the architectural beauty of the Old Parliament Building, a colonial-era structure with neoclassical influences. Adjacent to it stands the Colombo Lighthouse, offering a panoramic view of the city and the Indian Ocean.Lotus Tower is a prominent architectural landmark located in Colombo, the capital city of Sri Lanka. Also known as the Nelum Kuluna in Sinhala, the Lotus Tower stands as one of the tallest structures in South Asia and serves various purposes, including telecommunications, observation, and tourism.Embarking on a shopping tour in Colombo, the vibrant capital city of Sri Lanka, is an exciting and rewarding experience. Colombo, with its blend of modernity and tradition, offers a diverse range of shopping opportunities that cater to various tastes and preferences.
